tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Return the verbatim text of a Bible passage (up to 200 verses) in one public-domain translation, with a citation link. Examples: "John 3:16", "Psalm 23", "Genesis 1:1-2:3", "Esther 4", "Tobit 12", "1 Enoch 1:9".

tools.name: compare_translations
tools.description: Return the same reference side by side in 2 to 6 translations, e.g. Septuagint vs KJV. Default: lxx2012 and kjv. Useful where the Septuagint and Masoretic-based Bibles differ (Isaiah 7:14, Psalm 40:6, Deuteronomy 32:43, Esther, Daniel).

tools.name: search_scripture
tools.description: Find verses containing a phrase (case-insensitive substring match) in one translation. Returns up to 50 hits in canonical order with references and links.

tools.name: list_translations
tools.description: List the public-domain translations available, with translator, date, licence reasoning and upstream source.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List books in canonical order with chapter counts and which translations carry them, including the deuterocanonical books of the Septuagint.
